blurb: Knot Working offers offshore fishing charters including bottom fishing, trolling, or combo trips tailored to conditions and guests. Trips target species like snapper, grouper, amberjack, and pelagics. The charters are family-friendly and suitable for first-timers and seasoned anglers.
extraNote: A 15–20% gratuity for the first mate is customary · Safety comes first — trips may be cut short for unsafe or disorderly behavior
